text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Time for summer camp. Kitasan Black feels inferior compared to Tokai Teio and the other racers who possess an innate brilliance.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But for some reason, she doesn't get psyched out by Gold Ship or Vodka.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Umamusume tend to have either standard personalities or find themselves as oddball outliers.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Kitasan Black likely finds herself more at home with the oddball types. Talking with these two helps her overcome her inferiority complex.
